title: Scale Down to Speed Up: Dynamic Data Selection for Reinforcement Learning
authors_zh: Zhuoyue Chen, Jihai Zhang, Ben Liu, Fangquan Lin, Wotao Yin
paper_type_zh: 动态强化学习训练数据选择研究
best_for_zh: 适合设计算力受限的数学强化学习，并需要按训练阶段明确决定哪些提示应产生下一次策略更新的读者。
one_line: ScalingRL turns a 220K mathematical prompt pool into a dynamically sampled 1.5K RL curriculum using difficulty, reasoning complexity, and reward adaptability.
ScalingRL 用难度、推理复杂度和奖励适应性，把 22 万道数学题转化为动态抽取的 1,500 题强化学习课程。
why: It treats data use as an optimization schedule, rather than assuming that a fixed high-quality subset remains useful throughout RL.
inclusion_reason: It changes which mathematical prompts are consumed by RL at each training stage, using task difficulty, reasoning-path complexity, and current reward behavior to allocate optimization budget.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Large-scale reasoning RL commonly treats a prompt pool as static: every retained mathematical question is repeatedly available for policy updates. That wastes computation on questions already solved by the current policy, on questions so hard that they yield nearly uniform failure, and on long responses whose optimization dynamics may be unhelpful. A smaller fixed subset does not solve the second problem, because the usefulness of a prompt changes as the policy changes.

The paper asks how to decide which mathematical prompts should be used at each stage of RL, while preserving enough coverage for generalization. Its target is not a universal data-quality ranking. It is a stage-dependent training surface that selects questions with an appropriate current difficulty, a useful reasoning-path complexity, and a reward history capable of supplying a learning signal.

大规模推理强化学习通常把提示池视为静态资源：每一道保留下来的数学题都会反复用于策略更新。这会把计算浪费在当前策略已经解出的题目、难到几乎总是失败的题目，以及优化动态未必有益的长回答上。即使换成更小的固定子集，第二个问题仍然存在，因为题目的效用会随着策略变化而变化。

论文要回答的是，在保持足够覆盖以支持泛化的同时，如何决定强化学习每个阶段应使用哪些数学提示。它追求的不是一个通用的数据质量排序，而是一个随阶段变化的训练表面：选择当前难度合适、推理路径复杂度有用，并且奖励历史仍能提供学习信号的问题。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
ScalingRL separates one-time pool construction from repeated training-time selection. It first removes malformed, ambiguous, trivial, excessively long, and distributionally redundant records from a 220K mathematical pool, leaving an 8K candidate set with controlled topic and difficulty composition. The later decision is made within that candidate set rather than by committing to all of it for every update.

For each candidate, the Data Effectiveness Score combines relative difficulty, sampled chain-of-thought complexity, and recent reward adaptability. The preferred region moves through training: early updates favor questions near the pool's typical difficulty, while later updates move toward harder and more complex questions, excluding reward extremes that provide little gradient information. A decaying-temperature sampler converts the score into the next batch composition.

ScalingRL 将一次性的候选池构造与反复进行的训练时选择分开。它先从 22 万道数学题中删除字段错误、表述含混、过于简单、解答过长和分布上冗余的记录，得到一个题型与难度构成受到控制的 8 千题候选集。之后的决定发生在这个候选集中，而不是在每次更新时都固定使用全部候选题。

对于每个候选题，数据有效性分数结合相对难度、采样得到的思维链复杂度和近期奖励适应性。偏好的区域会随训练移动：早期更新偏向接近题池典型难度的问题，后期则转向更难、推理更复杂的问题，同时排除几乎不给梯度信息的极端奖励样本。温度逐渐下降的采样器把该分数转换为下一批数据的构成。

title: Method
方法
html:
The initial construction stage applies structural and mathematical-syntax checks, language-model clarity checks, domain stratification, and model-based difficulty bounds. Problems solved by Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B are removed as trivial; overly long solution traces are also excluded. The paper describes an 8K candidate set with 4.9K easy, 1.4K medium, and 2.1K hard examples, preserving those broad difficulty proportions while changing the sampled members over epochs.

During PPO training, difficulty is estimated from repeated DeepSeek-R1 answers, complexity from sampled solution length, and reward adaptability from recent mean reward. These terms form a learned weighted score. At every epoch, a temperature-controlled probability distribution and threshold choose the prompts used for rollouts; PPO then gives correct boxed answers a reward of 1, well-formatted wrong answers -0.5, and formatting failures -1.

初始构造阶段依次使用结构与数学语法检查、语言模型清晰度检查、领域分层和基于模型的难度边界。能被 Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B 解出的题目被视为过于简单而移除，解题轨迹过长的样本也会被排除。论文构造出 8 千题候选集，其中简单题 4,900 道、中等题 1,400 道、困难题 2,100 道；训练各轮保持这种大致难度比例，但会更换其中被抽取的具体题目。

在 PPO 训练中，难度由 DeepSeek-R1 的重复作答估计，复杂度由采样到的解答长度估计，奖励适应性则来自近期平均奖励。这些项构成一个可学习加权分数。每轮训练依据温度控制的概率分布和阈值选择用于生成轨迹的提示；随后 PPO 对正确的方框答案给 1 分，对格式正确但答案错误的结果给 -0.5 分，对格式错误给 -1 分。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
On a Qwen2.5-MATH-7B-Instruct backbone, the reported dynamic 1.5K-sample run reaches 84.2 on MATH500, 22.5 on AIME 2024, and 67.5 on AMC 2023, for a 58.1 average in the paper's comparison table. The same table reports 81.4, 22.5, and 63.3 for the static 8K filtered set, and 81.4, 20.3, and 58.6 for a random 1.5K subset. The paper also reports that the full three-term score outperforms every one- or two-term ablation on MATH500.

The efficiency claim is substantial but should be read as a reported experimental configuration, not a universal cost law. The authors contrast four hours on eight A800 GPUs for the 1.5K dynamic regime with thirteen days for the 220K regime, while also disclosing an approximately fourteen-to-fifteen-hour one-time construction pipeline. Evaluation covers MATH500, AIME 2024 and 2025, AMC 2023, and OlympiadBench, but all are mathematical reasoning settings.

在 Qwen2.5-MATH-7B-Instruct 骨干模型上，论文报告动态抽取的 1,500 题训练在 MATH500 上达到 84.2、在 AIME 2024 上达到 22.5、在 AMC 2023 上达到 67.5，比较表中的平均值为 58.1。相同表格中，静态 8 千题过滤集的结果为 81.4、22.5 和 63.3，随机 1,500 题子集为 81.4、20.3 和 58.6。论文还报告，完整的三项分数在 MATH500 上优于所有只保留一项或两项的消融版本。

效率主张很显著，但应把它理解为已报告的实验配置，而非普遍适用的成本规律。作者将动态 1,500 题方案在 8 张 A800 上的 4 小时，与 22 万题方案的 13 天相对比，同时披露了一次性候选构造约需 14 至 15 小时。评测覆盖 MATH500、AIME 2024 与 2025、AMC 2023 和 OlympiadBench，但全部仍属于数学推理场景。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The contribution is not simply that fewer examples can work. The paper turns a prompt's current training value into a three-part, time-varying decision: difficulty avoids both trivial and unreachable tasks, reasoning-path complexity controls the response-length dimension, and reward adaptability removes examples at reward saturation. This makes sample selection part of the learning schedule rather than a preprocessing choice made once.

It also couples broad distribution control to local adaptation. The 8K pool keeps a prescribed easy, medium, and hard composition, whereas the dynamic sampler chooses particular records within those groups as the policy evolves. Compared with a static curriculum or a reward-only filter, the design explicitly aims to preserve coverage while changing which records consume PPO rollout and update budget.

新意不只是“更少的样本也能有效”。论文把一个提示在当前时刻的训练价值变成三部分、随时间变化的决策：难度同时避开过于简单和无法达到的任务，推理路径复杂度控制回答长度这一维度，奖励适应性去除奖励已经饱和的样本。这样，样本选择成为学习日程的一部分，而不再只是一次性的预处理选择。

它还把整体分布控制与局部自适应结合起来。8 千题候选池维持预先规定的简单、中等和困难构成，而动态采样器会随策略演变，在这些组内选择具体记录。相对于静态课程或只看奖励的过滤器，该设计明确要在保持覆盖面的同时，改变哪些记录消耗 PPO 的轨迹生成与更新预算。

title: Limitations
局限
html: The reported initial curation still depends on heuristic thresholds, multiple external models, and quality judgments, so the claimed efficiency excludes some selection cost and may not transfer cleanly to another corpus. The evidence is confined to mathematical reasoning, PPO-style optimization, and a small set of model scales; it does not establish that the same score works for code, dialogue, multimodal data, or different reward designs. The official paper also does not declare code or a release of the final curated and dynamic subsets, which limits direct reproduction of the exact training surface.
论文报告的初始筛选仍依赖启发式阈值、多个外部模型和质量判断，因此所宣称的效率并未包含全部选择成本，也未必能无缝迁移到另一套语料。证据局限于数学推理、PPO 式优化和少数模型规模，不能证明同一分数也适用于代码、对话、多模态数据或不同的奖励设计。官方论文还没有声明代码或最终过滤集与动态子集的发布，这限制了对其精确训练表面的直接复现。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use this paper when an RL pipeline must decide continuously how to spend scarce rollout and update budget across a known prompt pool. Its most transferable lesson is to separate coverage-preserving pool construction from model-state-dependent sampling, then make the sampling score depend on signals that predict useful optimization rather than on generic quality alone. It is especially useful as a design reference for a mathematical RL curriculum, but any reuse should replace its source-specific filters, external-model estimators, and reward thresholds with audited choices for the target domain.
当一个强化学习流程必须持续决定如何把有限的轨迹生成和更新预算分配到已知提示池中时，可以使用这篇论文。它最可迁移的启发是先构造一个保持覆盖面的候选池，再依据模型状态抽样，并让抽样分数依赖能预测有效优化的信号，而不只依赖通用质量。它特别适合作为数学强化学习课程的设计参考；但在其他领域复用时，应以目标领域经过审计的选择取代其源数据专用的过滤器、外部模型估计器和奖励阈值。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: Read the paper as an argument about training consumption, not as a claim that 1.5K is inherently sufficient. Trace the three decisions separately: what enters the 8K pool, how DES changes its preferred difficulty and complexity over time, and how the thresholded sampler changes actual PPO batches. When comparing its numbers with other compact-data RL work, include the one-time curation cost, the upstream data terms, the evaluator and reward contract, and the absence of an official release for the final selected subsets.
阅读这篇论文时，应把它理解为关于训练数据如何被消费的论证，而不是“1,500 题天然足够”的主张。请分别追踪三个决定：哪些记录进入 8 千题候选池，数据有效性分数如何随时间改变偏好的难度与复杂度，以及带阈值的采样器如何改变实际的 PPO 批次。把它与其他紧凑数据强化学习工作比较时，应计入一次性筛选成本、上游数据条款、评测器和奖励契约，以及最终所选子集没有官方发布这一事实。

Exploration rollouts use 1.2; sampling temperature decays by epoch.
Reduce 220K prompts to 8K using quality, diversity, and difficulty filters; rank the candidate pool by a learned weighted sum of difficulty, chain-of-thought complexity, and reward adaptability.
The reported dynamic training subset contains 1.5K labeled problems after an 8K candidate construction stage.
PPO with rule-based correctness and format rewards, actor learning rate 5e-7, critic learning rate 9e-6, and KL coefficient 0.01.
Public mathematical problems from the OpenR1-Math-220k mixture, including AIME, AMC, Olympiads, and AoPS.
